description: This file defines the HarTracer class responsible for capturing and exporting HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser or network request activities within the Playwright testing framework. It manages event listeners, request/response processing, and HAR log generation.

classes.name: HarTracer
classes.description: Class responsible for tracing network requests and responses to generate HAR logs, supporting start, stop, and flush operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and begins HAR data collection based on provided options.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops HAR collection, removes event listeners, and compiles the HAR log.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits for all ongoing request processing to complete.
